body.name: Observable two-wave population-variance statistic
body.construction: Compute \(\widehat\tau_n^{(w)}=N_n^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_n}Z_{n,i}^{(w)}\) for \(w\in\{1,2\}\), then set \(\widehat\Omega_n^{12}=\sum_{k=-2r}^{2r}\{N_{n,k}^{-1}\sum_{i\in J_{n,k}}Z_{n,i}^{(1)}Z_{n,i+k}^{(2)}-\widehat\tau_n^{(1)}\widehat\tau_n^{(2)}\}\). The only nuisance quantities are the two displayed wave means; \(p\) and \(\pi_i(a)\) are known from the randomization.
